title: Tandem protocol test-vector manifest (E01-16)
description: One JSON manifest per vector category under protocol/vectors/, produced by tools/vectors/generate.py. See protocol/vectors/README.md for the format contract.

$schema.description: Relative path back to this schema, for editor tooling.

category.description: Stable, kebab-case name of the vector category (e.g. spki-fingerprint).

generatedBy.description: Every manifest is produced by the reference generator; hand-edits are rejected by the regeneration check.

id.description: Unique within this manifest; stable across regenerations.

input.description: Category-defined input. Not text-safe payloads reference a file under protocol/vectors/fixtures/<category>/ by relative path instead of inlining bytes (see README).

expected.description: Positive-case expected output. Mutually exclusive with expectedError.

expectedError.description: Stable, camelCase error name for a negative case. Mutually exclusive with expected.

closeCode.description: SPEC.md #errors-and-close-codes name, present only when the negative case closes a connection (E01-05).

localReason.description: Category-defined local diagnostic reason grouped under closeCode (e.g. TOO_LARGE under MALFORMED_FRAME, per SPEC.md); never sent on the wire.
